models.name: Qwen3.8-27B

engines.hardware: NVIDIA RTX 4090 24GB, CPU attention fallback (one box)
engines.quant: Qwen3.8-27B with -ctk q5_1 KV cache; flash-attn has no CUDA kernel for q5_1 so attention silently falls back to CPU; this is a degraded configuration vs ~2185 tok/s prompt with q8_0 KV (llama.cpp issue 28455)

models.why: Wrong-KV-flag pitfall: llama.cpp's default flash-attn only carries CUDA kernels for f16/q8_0/q4_0, so -ctk q5_1 fell back to CPU attention (18 tok/s prompt vs ~2185 with q8_0).

models.why: Google's edge path: LiteRT-LM on a Pi 5 hits 9 tok/s decode at 1432 MB peak RAM.
